title: Affine derived pushforward is t-exact and conservative
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. On the derived categories of complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-pc-derived-category], the derived direct image $Rf_*:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] is t-exact for the standard t-structures [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category] (restricted to $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}$) and reflects isomorphisms. Equivalently, an object $E$ of $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)$ lies in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}^{\leq n}(X)$ (respectively $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}^{\geq n}(X)$) exactly when $Rf_*E$ does, and a morphism is an isomorphism whenever its derived direct image is an isomorphism.
